title: StereoKG: Data-Driven Knowledge Graph Construction for Cultural Knowledge and Stereotypes

bias_targets.methodology: Sentiment analysis of verbalized knowledge graph triples about 5 religious groups, Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) based association analysis to identify frequent stereotypical tokens, and evaluating Masked Language Modeling (MLM) prediction accuracy on masked stereotype sentences.
